//! モジュールの doc（`code` と [リンク](crate::x)）
#![allow(dead_code)]
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};
use std::fmt::{self, Display};

/// 構造体の doc
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Point<T: Copy + Default = f64> {
    pub x: T,
    y: T,
}

pub enum Shape<'a> { Circle { r: f32 }, Poly(&'a [Point]), Unit }

impl<T: Copy + Default + Display> Display for Point<T> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "({}, {})", self.x, self.y)
    }
}

pub trait Area { const SIDES: u8 = 0; fn area(&self) -> f64; }

macro_rules! square { ($e:expr) => { $e * $e }; }

async fn fetch(url: &str) -> Result<String, Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>> {
    let raw = r#"raw "string" with # sign"#;
    let bytes = b"bytes\x00\n";
    let ch = '\u{1F600}';
    let n = 0x1F_u32 + 0o17 + 0b1010 + 1_000i64 as u32 + 1.5e-3 as u32;
    let closure = |a: i32, b| -> i32 { a + b };
    let label = 'outer: loop { break 'outer 42; };
    if let Some(v @ 1..=9) = Some(3) { println!("{v} {}", square!(n)); }
    match url.len() { 0 => return Err("empty".into()), x if x > 10 => {}, _ => unreachable!() }
    let map: HashMap<&str, Vec<u8>> = HashMap::new();
    let _ = (raw, bytes, ch, closure, label, map, BTreeMap::<u8, u8>::new());
    Ok(format!("{url:?}"))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn 名前() { assert_eq!(Point { x: 1.0, y: 2.0 }.to_string(), "(1, 2)"); }
} // tests の終わり
